projection: equirectangular, north up, east to the right; rolled onto the previous site map, lon -180 at the centre
normal: tangent space x=east y=north z=up (OpenGL), true scale from the New Horizons DEM 300 m, xy scaled by the resolution map Q x DEM coverage (feather 128 px); flat where the DEM has no data
colour: previous site map (NASA enhanced colour, Lanczos 4k -> 8k) at all frequencies; New Horizons detail (L / gauss(L, 8 px)) multiplied in with weight 0.8 x Q (fine/coarse band ratio vs Sputnik/Tombaugh), zero where the local old/new shift exceeds 1.5 px at 2k
source: USGS Astrogeology: Pluto New Horizons Global Mosaic 300m (Jul 2017), Pluto New Horizons Global DEM 300m (Jul 2017)
